heading: Projects

empty.title: No projects found.

target.label: Backup target
target.noSnapshot: This agent hasn't reported yet — check back shortly.
target.noAgentsHint: Register a fleet agent first, then choose it here to create a project.

agent.notReportedHint: No snapshot received yet — check the Fleet page to confirm the agent is online.
agent.notReportedTabHint: No snapshot from this agent yet. If the agent is online but this persists, it is likely running an outdated image — on the host, run: docker compose -f docker-compose.agent.yml pull && docker compose -f docker-compose.agent.yml up -d --force-recreate, then click Refresh now.

folders.emptyHintAgent: This agent's /var/www snapshot is empty. On the agent host, run: docker compose -f docker-compose.agent.yml exec agent ls -la /var/www. Your projects must be mounted under /var/www.

docker.unavailableHint: No Docker socket is configured on this server.
docker.unavailableHintAgent: This agent's latest snapshot reports Docker unavailable. On the agent host, rerun setup with: docker compose -f docker-compose.agent.yml pull && docker compose -f docker-compose.agent.yml up -d --force-recreate. Then click Refresh now.
docker.emptyHint: Start a Compose project, then refresh.

badges.outsideRootsHint: This project's folder is not covered by the agent's project directories ({{roots}}). Re-run the agent setup with this directory added.

review.title: Review and create
